title: Cartwise Gift Cards Training Q&A: Balance Merges and Restricted Order Lines
content:
**The rule.** A Cartwise Gift Cards card whose card type allows a balance merge may move its whole balance, if at least the card type's smallest mergeable balance, onto a Cartwise Reloadable Gift Card of the same holder, provided the receiving card stays within its largest balance; the sending card is then depleted. Bonus value never moves in a merge, and it lapses on the sending card. Card value never pays alcohol lines, and it pays shopper tips and Cartwise+ fees only where the card type allows tips and Cartwise+ fees to be paid.

## Merges

**What does a merge move?**
The whole balance of the sending card, other than bonus value. The balance leaves the sending card and arrives on the receiving card as one transfer, and the sending card is then depleted.

**Onto which card can a balance be merged?**
Only onto a Cartwise Reloadable Gift Card belonging to the same holder as the sending card.

**Which cards can send a balance?**
Only a card whose card type allows a balance merge, and only when its balance is at least that card type's smallest mergeable balance.

**What limits the receiving card?**
The receiving card must stay within its largest balance: its balance after the merge may not exceed the largest balance a Cartwise Reloadable Gift Card may carry.

**What happens to bonus value on the sending card?**
It does not move. It lapses on the sending card.

### Merge conditions at a glance

| Condition | Must hold for a merge |
|---|---|
| The sending card's type allows a balance merge | Yes |
| The sending balance is at least the smallest mergeable balance | Yes |
| The receiving card is a Cartwise Reloadable Gift Card | Yes |
| Both cards belong to the same holder | Yes |
| The receiving card's balance after the merge is within its largest balance | Yes |

A merge takes place only when all five conditions hold.

### Hypothetical merge checks (illustrative inputs only)

Assume a receiving Cartwise Reloadable Gift Card whose largest balance is 1000.00, and a sending card of a type that allows a merge with a smallest mergeable balance of 1.00, both held by the same holder.

| Sending balance | Receiving balance before | Receiving balance after | Merge possible? |
|---|---|---|---|
| 60.00 | 940.00 | 1000.00 | Yes — equal to the largest balance |
| 60.00 | 950.00 | 1010.00 | No — above the largest balance |
| 0.50 | 300.00 | — | No — below the smallest mergeable balance |

## Restricted order lines

**Can gift card value pay for alcohol?**
No. Card value never pays alcohol lines, on any card type.

**Can gift card value pay a shopper tip or a Cartwise+ fee?**
Only where the card's type allows it: tips only where tips are payable with that card type, and Cartwise+ fees only where Cartwise+ fees are payable with that card type.
